Trust rule: current source and focused receipts outrank this index, knowledge artifacts, memory, and generated graphs. The baseline docs are stale where HEAD differs. Deployed Firebase state is unknown until authorized receipts prove it.

Safety rule: offline and emulator-only by default. Never read or reproduce credentials. Never seed, clean, migrate, deploy, or access a live Firebase project without explicit authorization for the exact target and action.
